title: Grow a Garden Moon Egg Guide: Pets, How to Get Them, and Abilities
meta_description: Learn how to get Grow a Garden Moon Eggs from the Harvest Moon shop, Moon Team Event, and Moon Coin loop, plus all four hatch pets, odds, and abilities.
content_md:
The Harvest Moon **Moon Egg** is a **Legendary** egg that hatches one of four event pets after **4 hours**. It landed on **August 1, 2026** with the [Harvest Moon Event](/events/grow-a-garden). Do not mix it up with the older **Night Egg** from Lunar Glow or Blood Moon: different egg, different pets, different event.

## How to get Moon Eggs in Grow a Garden

### Buy from the Moon Event Shop

The **Moon Event Shop** restocks every **15 minutes**. That is where most players pick up standard Moon Eggs.

1. **Farm Moon Coins** (see below) or keep Robux ready.
2. **Open the Moon Event Shop** while Harvest Moon is live.
3. **Buy a Moon Egg** when it appears. The event master shop table lists **50 Moon Coins** or **149 Robux**, an **8.33%** restock chance, and **1 to 2** stock per restock.
4. **Equip the egg**, place it in your garden, wait **4 hours**, then hold **E** to hatch.

The dedicated Moon Egg wiki line still lists **40 Moon Coins** and a **5%** restock rate. That may reflect an earlier shop value. If your shop shows a different price, trust what you see in game.

### Earn Moon Coins for shop eggs

Moon Coins come from a short Harvest Moon loop:

1. **Place 10 unfavorited fruits** on **Moon Pedestals** to summon **10 minutes** of Harvest Moon weather.
2. **Grow crops during that weather** so they can roll the **Moonbeam** mutation.
3. **Sell Moonbeam fruit** at the **Moon Sell Stand** for Moon Coins.

Favorited fruits cannot be sacrificed on pedestals. Keep a separate stack of fodder fruit for farming runs.

### Moon Team Event eggs (free route)

You can also earn Moon Eggs without spending every coin. The **Moon Team Event** track pays **3 Moon Eggs** at each of these stages:

| Stage | Points needed | Moon Eggs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 3,500 | 3 |
| 4 | 18,000 | 3 |
| 6 | 22,500 | 3 |

That is **9 Moon Eggs** total on the full team track. Handy when the shop keeps dodging restocks.

### Premium Moon Egg (Robux fast hatch)

The **Premium Moon Egg** from the Limited Time Shop hatches in **30 seconds** instead of 4 hours. Robux bundles cost **149**, **429**, **1,249**, or **4,999**. Same four pets as the standard egg, with tiny odds shifts (Opposum drops from **55%** to **54%** on premium). Less waiting, more Robux.

**Vampire Squid** also sits in the Moon Event Shop for **120 Moon Coins**, but it is a direct shop pet, not a Moon Egg hatch.

## All Moon Egg pets, hatch chances, and abilities

Every standard Moon Egg rolls from the same four-pet pool. Most hatches land on Opposum or Lunar Moth (**90%** combined). Moon Dragon is the **0.5%** chase hatch, roughly **1 in 200**.

| Pet | Hatch chance | Tier | Hunger | Ability |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Opposum | 55% | Rare | 20,000 | **Night Support:** when Night-type pets finish an ability, their cooldown starts with less time left |
| Lunar Moth | 35% | Legendary | 25,000 | **Moonsong:** occasionally sings; nearby plants grow every second and nearby pets regain hunger every second |
| Night Horse | 9.5% | Mythical | 66,000 | **Selenic Steed:** occasionally sacrifices a random fruit to apply **Moonbeam** to random fruits in your garden |
| Moon Dragon | 0.5% | Prismatic | 300,000 | **Draconis Luna:** mutates up to as many fruits as you have Night-type pets with **Moonlit** or **Moonbeam**; each mutated fruit can randomly level up a pet by 1 |

Ability descriptions in game do not list exact trigger intervals or cooldown seconds. Treat Moonsong, Selenic Steed, and Draconis Luna as occasional effects, not on-demand buttons.

**Opposum** is the common hatch. Night Support shaves time off Night pet cooldowns after they finish an ability. Fine if you already run a Night team, underwhelming as your only pet.

**Lunar Moth** is the practical pick for everyday farming. Moonsong keeps nearby crops moving and feeds nearby pets while it sings. One hatch that helps the whole garden.

**Night Horse** matters when Harvest Moon weather is off. Selenic Steed applies **Moonbeam** to random fruits by sacrificing another fruit, so you can keep Moonbeam sales going between moons.

**Moon Dragon** is the prismatic long shot. Draconis Luna scales with how many Night-type pets you own and can spike pet levels through fruit mutations. Nice when it hits, not worth banking on.

Want wider pet rankings? Check the [Grow a Garden pets tier list](/articles/grow-a-garden-pets-tier-list-best-pets-to-choose). If pet hunger is new to you, the [feed a pet guide](/articles/grow-a-garden-feed-a-pet-guide) covers the basics. Compare other hatch pools on the [eggs wiki page](/wiki/grow-a-garden/eggs) and [pets wiki page](/wiki/grow-a-garden/pets), or grab live [codes](/codes/grow-a-garden) when they drop.

faq_json.q: Is the Moon Egg the same as the Night Egg in Grow a Garden?
faq_json.a: No. The Moon Egg is the Legendary Harvest Moon egg added August 1, 2026. The Night Egg is an older Lunar Glow and Blood Moon egg with a different pet pool.

faq_json.q: How long does a Moon Egg take to hatch?
faq_json.a: A standard Moon Egg takes 4 hours after you place it in your garden. Premium Moon Eggs from the Limited Time Shop hatch in 30 seconds.

faq_json.q: What is the rarest Moon Egg pet?
faq_json.a: Moon Dragon at 0.5% hatch chance. Opposum is the most common at 55%.

faq_json.q: Is the Premium Moon Egg worth it?
faq_json.a: Only if you want the same four pets without a 4-hour wait. Premium eggs cost more Robux and shift odds slightly, but they do not add new pets to the pool.
